caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic figurine of a standing person dressed in historical or theatrical attire. The figure is positioned upright, wearing a knee-length tunic with a sash draped diagonally across the chest and a decorative headdress with plume-like forms at the top. The individual holds an object resembling a fan or a set of pipes in both hands, positioned vertically in front of their chest. The attire and details are accentuated with blue color, contrasting against the primarily off-white or cream surface of the figurine. The legs are bent at the knees with boots outlined in blue. The base of the sculpture is wider and is colored in solid blue. Surrounding the lower half of the figure, particularly on the base, are rounded and textured shapes that appear to represent rocks, with occasional small animal forms; these are also highlighted with blue. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, leaving the focus solely on the figurine.
title: Statuette
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
